frost.source: ETCCDI core climate index FD: frost days, daily minimum below 0 °C

heat.source: Local 95th percentile of daily maximum temperature, 2001–2025 (35.2 °C), our analysis of NASA POWER

extreme_rain.source: ETCCDI core climate index R20mm: days with 20 mm or more

soil_alert.source: Percentile 20 or below matches US Drought Monitor class D1 (moderate drought, percentiles 10–20) or worse
